CustomField.description: TNCI-139 / ELV-CPQ-036. REVERTED 2026-08-20 to the original CPQ-equivalent arithmetic. A /100 divisor was added on 2026-08-19 in the belief that a Percent field is read by a formula as its displayed number; that belief is wrong. Salesforce evaluates a Percent field in a formula as a fraction, proven in this org by Opportunity.Incoming_ARR_after_Split__c, where 1,862,230.75 * Split_Percent__c of 50 yields 931,115.38. The divisor therefore understated the impact by 100x and has been removed. This field now matches CPQ Marketplace_Day_1_ARR_Impact__c verbatim, as it did originally.
CustomField.label: Marketplace Sales ARR Impact
